author: SGMC
body:
Wow, how long has it been since I last made a post here? 5, 6 months? I wonder if anyone remembers me. Well of course you don't, I changed my name multiple times :P 

I was just looking through my channel's old videos, back from 2012... found a little gem of me playing Walls... Man, the memories are real!


Oh, old lobby... you were a good lobby...
This seems so long ago... back when I thought saying "ur" and using no punctuation wouldn't lower people's respect towards me in the chat. And when I said "XD" instead of "xD" and used double-tap to sprint and had no idea what strafing is and generally didn't know how to PvP... man, those were the days. My voice was so ridiculously squeaky, too. Hard to believe that was only 2 years ago!
